title: Small agents. Big room to experiment.
summary: A starting point for tool-using agents, with a little less ceremony and a lot more intentional supervision.

body.heading: Meet smolagents
body.text: Hugging Face smolagents is a library for building agents, including agents that express actions in code. Explore the official repository and documentation before choosing an execution setup.

body.heading: Give the agent a narrow job
body.text: Start with a low-stakes task such as summarizing a small set of public documents. Grant only the tools it needs. Use isolated execution and review outputs before allowing external actions.

body.heading: Share the whole experiment
body.text: Tell the community what the agent was asked to do, which tools and model it used, where it failed, and how a human checked the result. A thoughtful failure report counts as a valuable contribution.
